questions.text: Do you enjoy working with numbers, formulas, logic, and patterns?
Do you enjoy creating visuals, layouts, or designing experiences?
Do you enjoy solving puzzles, debugging, and tackling challenging problems?
Do you enjoy explaining technical concepts to others or writing about tech?
Do you enjoy working meticulously on precise tasks where small errors matter?
Are you excited by learning cutting-edge technologies and experimenting with them?
Do you prefer working alone or collaborating in teams?
Do you enjoy long-term learning and experimentation, or prefer immediate results?
Do you enjoy building and implementing systems, or theorizing and designing them?
Do you enjoy working on business solutions, understanding user needs, and improving processes?
